The Syrian civil war, which began in 2011, has been a devastating conflict marked by complex political, sectarian, and international dimensions. Initially sparked by pro-democracy protests against President Bashar al-Assad's regime, the conflict escalated into a brutal war involving multiple factions, including rebel groups, government forces, ISIS, and Kurdish militias. The war has resulted in immense civilian suffering, widespread displacement, and profound humanitarian crises. International involvement has further complicated efforts to reach a peaceful resolution, making the Syrian civil war a tragic and ongoing global concern.

About the Channel:
Nitish Rajput firmly believes that there are adequate tools available online, and people can be brought together, informed, and educated collectively. 
Social media and the Internet have the power to create any narrative but this channel will use the same to curate a healthy, informative narrative that can genuinely benefit people in forming an opinion that is backed by facts and uncompromised information without any bias. Nitish Rajput wants to empower and facilitate people to challenge atrocities and become more vocal about issues plaguing Indian society.
